[[Kepkhet Marrowfeast]] is the "[[Aurek the Scarab Hunter|Queen of the Scarabs]]" (or simply "Scarab Queen"). She and her brood were attracted to [[Prophet's Path]] by the excessive death of [[Desert Griffon]]s.

== Notes ==
*Unlike other scarabs, she is a ranged attacker.
*Sometimes she is hidden at first and won't [[popup|pop up]] until a party member approaches her [[spawn]] point. 
*She is surrounded by several [[Scarab Nest Builder]]s who use lots of [[traps]]. [[Melee]] characters should be especially careful.
*The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet won't move if attacked from [[flatbow]] or [[longbow]] range.
*Kepkhet can be [[pull]]ed and won't return to the nest if at least one of the Scarab Nest Builders has been killed.
*If she casts [[Mark of Protection]] on herself, applying a [[condition]] or [[hex]] will cause her to use [[Contemplation of Purity]] which will remove Mark of Protection.
*[[Aurek the Scarab Hunter]] in [[Augury Rock (outpost)]] tells you of her existence and that he has been hunting her.

== Trivia ==
* Kepkhet was introduced in the [[Game updates/20060302|March 2, 2006]] update.
* She is the only non-[[mission]] permanent [[Crystal Desert]] boss that uses an [[elite skill]].
* Among [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]] bosses:
** She is one of the few that appears in the same place each time a party enters the zone.
** She is the only one which [[drop]]s a [[unique item]] outside of [[Elite Mission]]-related areas ([[Grenth's Footprint]], [[Sorrow's Furnace]], and [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]]).
** Can drop the [[unique item]] twice in the same kill.
